text:
Ivy: Quick thread to lock down DP stakeholder commitments + a feedback-routing matrix. Goal: onboard 5 high-quality partners in 10 weeks and make feedback -> priority deterministic.
Noel: Love it. Please call out tiers, expected cost, and a simple scoring rule we can explain to Finance and Eng.
Ivy: Draft tiers: Starter (early access, no credits, 2-wk onboarding), Partner ($4k credits + 4 office hours, 3-wk onboarding), Strategic ($18k credits + 30h SRE + roadmap slot, 6-wk stability commit). For on-prem Strategic add one-time install stipend $6k.
Rae: Success gates to keep a partner in "active" cohort: by day 30 either 1) >=12 valid calls/day OR 2) running daily evals for 7 consecutive days with quality within 3% of baseline. Otherwise offer downgrade to Partner/Starter.
Carlos: Security ops: intake must record data_classification (NONE/PII/PHI/PCI), KMS_required (y/n), logs_allowed (y/n). Any PHI/PCI auto-esc to Sec with 48h SLA for review. Add NDA addendum checkbox.
Priya: Feedback routing matrix (canonical fields captured on intake + console tag `dp:stake`) -> triage board lanes. Proposed scoring formula (explainable):
```
base = 3 if reproducible == "yes" else 0
impact = 2 if business_impact == "high" else 1 if business_impact == "medium" else 0
visibility = 1 if user_visible == "yes" else 0
tier_weight = 1.25 if tier == "Strategic" else 1.1 if tier == "Partner" else 1.0
priority_score = (base + impact + visibility) * tier_weight
```
Map priority_score: >=7 -> P0 (owner: Eng + 48h response SLA), 5-6 -> P1 (owner: Product + respond 5bd), <=4 -> backlog/watch (owner: PM).
Noel: Add operational escalation column: P0 -> paging to oncall SRE + @eng-runtime, P1 -> ticket + weekly sync, backlog -> triage cadence monthly. Also include auto-export to GH issues with label `dp/triage`.
dp-bot: Intake form published: https://internal.redwood/dp/stake-intake (auto-tag: dp:stake). Submission -> creates triage card and optional GH issue. :rocket:
Carlos: For Strategic partners we must require a signed runbook acceptance and 30d commit to pilot. Also propose a one-click rollback plan template in onboarding.
Rae: Onboarding checklist (week-level): Week0 access + API keys, Week1 dataset ingest + eval prompts, Week2 baseline metrics & smoke, Week3 optimization window, Week4-6 stability runs for Strategic. I'll draft templates.
Ivy: Launch gating for partner launches: staging infra SLOs hold 72h, no quality regression >1% vs partner baseline, partner E2E tests green. If gate fails, 3-day hotfix + canary rollback.
Priya: Measurement signals to collect: daily_active_calls, regen_rate, false_positive_rate, partner_nps, p50/p95 latency. All evals tagged with partner_id for analysis.
Noel: Cost estimate (rough monthly): Starter $90, Partner $1,100, Strategic $4,500 (credits + SRE amortized). Finance to confirm.
Ivy: Action items: @Noel - confirm finance numbers with Ops/Fin; @Carlos - add security intake + runbook template; @Rae - post onboarding + gating templates; @Priya - wire scoring into triage board; @Ivy - finalize incentive T&Cs and publish intake FAQ. Reconvene next Thu to lock terms.
Priya: I'll prototype the triage board today and push example GH exports.
Carlos: Security checklist + NDA addendum doc will be in PR by EOD.
Rae: Onboarding playbook draft by tomorrow AM.
Ivy: Thanks team  keep the cohort narrow, measurable, and quick to iterate. :seedling:
